title: Amplify security headers: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy
description:
`customHttp.yml` sets COOP, COEP and CORP (needed for SharedArrayBuffer) but no `Content-Security-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Content-Type-Options` or `Referrer-Policy`. The app handles Cognito and Google sign-in (`web/src/data/auth.ts`), so a CSP matters. No committed secrets were found; `web/amplify_outputs.json` is gitignored.

Done when: the four headers are set, the CSP allows the wasm, worker and worklet sources plus the Amplify and Google endpoints and nothing else, and `scripts/prod-smoke.sh` asserts they are present.
